address: 64 argiedereko bidea - quartier Boxate, Ainhoa, 64250, France
bio: Piperade egg revisited; Axuria cooperative veal with gnocchi and chanterelles; Argi Eder tart with caramel, vanilla and yellow lemon – the menu at this spruce rustic-style restaurant comprises fine cuisine with a Basque flavour, devised by a chef with a passion for local produce. Run by the same family for generations and surrounded by greenery, the hotel it is part of is an oasis of calm....
